description:
FlightPowers Airbnb search: live Airbnb stays and prices for a destination and dates, read from Airbnb's public search page at request time. Returns each stay's name, stay total, per-night price, currency, rating out of 5, review count, room type, bedrooms, beds, baths and Airbnb link: 10 stays by default, the cheapest always among them.

The guest counts, price, bedroom, bed, bathroom and room-type filters are Airbnb's own; min_rating and sort are applied by FlightPowers to the one page of stays the search returned. Prices are Airbnb's displayed totals for the dates; whether they include taxes is not stated by the page, so taxes_included is null. Rates go stale within minutes: a current price comes from a new search. Data read from Airbnb's public pages; FlightPowers is not affiliated with Airbnb.

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. "eur"; USD when omitted.

limit.description: Stays returned (default 10), in search order (after `sort`), with the cheapest always included.

min_rating.description: Lowest rating kept, out of 5; unrated stays are left out.

price_max.description: Highest price per night, in `currency` (Airbnb's nightly rate, before fees; price_total includes fees and can exceed price_max x nights).

price_min.description: Lowest price per night, in `currency` (Airbnb's nightly rate, before fees).

room_types.description: Room types to keep, e.g. ["Entire home/apt"].

sort.description: price_asc or price_desc by per-night price, rating_desc by rating; unset keeps Airbnb's order.

verbose.description: Returns the source's full rows (image, coordinates and more), every stay unless limit is set.

name: search_airbnb

outputSchema.description: Stays for one destination and one pair of dates. A refusal (no usable key, no Airbnb Live API subscription) carries needs_api_key, signup_url and message, and an empty results.

api_usage.description: What this call cost the caller's RapidAPI plan (one request), and what remains on it.

filters_applied.description: Each filter applied, and whether Airbnb or FlightPowers (post_filter) applied it.

needs_api_key.description: True when no usable RapidAPI key arrived with the call, or the upstream rejected the one that did. No search was run and nothing was billed; signup_url and message describe the fix.

quota_exhausted.description: True when the caller's RapidAPI plan has no requests left for the current period.

results.description: The stays: at most `limit` (default 10), compact rows unless `verbose: true`. taxes_included is null: the page does not state whether its totals include taxes.

search_status.description: 'ok': stays listed. 'empty': the page listed none for these dates, a real answer.

signup_url.description: Where the caller subscribes or changes plan.

outputSchema.title: Airbnb search result

title: FlightPowers: search Airbnb stays
